relevantItems: #23234 makes the New Stats chart metric selectable.
#23278 adds interactive bar selection and updates related values from the selected bucket.
#23287 revises period presets to distinguish rolling and calendar ranges.
#23337 keeps the selected period type while paging backward and forward.
#23393 falls back to Views for an hourly chart when necessary.
#23389 presents plan upsell for eligible gated stats.
#23394 aligns metric tabs and Today behavior.

items.summary: Selectable metrics update the chart from data already loaded for the period.
Latest Post Summary and per-post stats; retained as boundary context and excluded from scored scope.
Chart bars support soft selection, clearing, moving, and drill-down.
Period presets distinguish rolling windows, calendar periods, and custom ranges.
Period origin survives paging and state restoration.
Calendar charts retain the whole period, including non-actionable future buckets.
Eligible restricted endpoints use a plan-gated state rather than generic retry.
Hourly charts fall back safely while retaining the user's compatible metric preference.
Metric tabs and Today interaction are aligned with the revised experience.
Recently viewed periods can render cached data and revalidate it.
Chart and list requests share aligned period definitions.
Interaction analytics; retained as boundary context and excluded from scored scope.
